spans.s:
अभुक्त अ-भुक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. भुज्), un-
eaten; unenjoyed, unused, unexpended; one who
has not eaten, enjoyed or expended.
—अभुक्त-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has not eaten.

अ-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. one who has not experi-
enced or enjoyed, one who does not keep (a promise).

अ-भुञ्जत्, अन्, अती, अत्, not eating; Ved. not allow-
ing to enjoy; not protecting.

अभुग्न अ-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, not bent,
straight; well, free from disease.

आभुग्न आ-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 1. भुज् with
3. आ implying diminution), a little curved or bent.
अभुज अ-भुज, अस्, आ, अम्, armless, maimed.

अभुजिष्य अ-भुजिष्य, अस्, आ, m. f. not a
slave, not a servant.

अभू अ-भू, ऊस्, m. unborn; an epithet of
Viṣṇu.

आभु आभु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. empty; one
whose hands are empty; stingy; (Sāy.) pervading,
reaching.

आभू 1. आ-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्,
to be present, continue one's existence.

2. आ-भू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. strong, sufficient, effica-
cious; (Sāy.) approaching (as a praiser); a prison, a
place of confinement; applied according to rule (as a
hymn); very prosperous.

अ-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, non-existent, whatever is not
or has not been.
—अभूत-तद्भाव, अस्, m. the
coming into being of that which has not existed before.
—अ-भूत-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, unprecedented.
—अ-
भूत-प्रादुर्भाव, अस्, m. the becoming manifest
of what has not been before.
—अभूत-रजस्, असस्,
m. pl., N. of some deities supposed to have existed
in the fifth Manvantara.
—अ-भूत-शत्रु, उस्, उस्, उस्, उ,
having no enemy.
अ-भूति, इस्, f. non-existence; want of power; poverty.

आ-भूति, इस्, f., Ved. capability, efficiency; (Sāy.)
overpowering strength; (इस्), m., N. of a man.

अभूमि अ-भूमि, इस्, f. non-earth, anything
but earth; no proper object, unfit place or object.

—अभूमि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in unfit or un-
suitable ground.

अभूयिष्ठ अ-भूयिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, few,
scanty.
अभूरि अ-भूरि, इस्, इस्, इ, few, some, several.

अभूष अ-भूष or अ-भूषित, अस्, आ, अम्,
unadorned.

आभूक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. empty, having no con-
tents, powerless.

आ-भूषेण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be obeyed;
(Sāy.) praiseworthy.

आभूष् आ-भूष्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -भूषति,
-षितुम्, to adorn, to adorn with one's presence, i. e.
to come.
